name: zclass_world_get_pending_fog_state
description: zClass_World::GetPendingFogState reads the pending fog state through the world class data and returns 0.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450b90 validates fastcall world in ecx, outState in edx, direct read of worldData fog state at offset 0x10, return 0, and no callees.
The native smoke sets pending fog state and verifies GetPendingFogState returns the stored value before ApplyPendingFogSettings consumes it.
